name: S-VHS Prosumer Deck
description: Super-VHS (S-VHS) deck. Separate Y/C output bypasses composite re-encoding, dramatically improving chroma quality. Used by prosumers and semi-professional production in the 1990s.
notes: S-VHS tapes require higher-coercivity oxide (900 Oe vs 650 Oe for standard VHS). Playing S-VHS tapes on a standard VHS deck produces severe dropout due to mismatched bias.
